name: selfirst
label: Take care of yourself first before others

questions.text:
As I read each of the following statements, please tell me whether you strongly agree, agree, neither agree or disagree, disagree, or strongly disagree with it. 
A. You have to take care of yourself first, and if you have any energy left over, then help other people.

name: richpoor
label: Ok to get rich even if others poor

questions.text:
As I read each of the following statements, please tell me whether you strongly agree, agree, neither agree or disagree, disagree, or strongly disagree with it. 
B. People should be allowed to accumulate as much wealth as they can even if some make millions while others live in poverty.
